product_metadata.title: Wilton Sugar Cookie Decorating Kit, 15-Piece - Tool Set, Meringue Powder, Icing Colors, and Decorating Bottle
features: Creating fun designs on cookies with royal icing is easy with this decorating set
Includes: Meringue mix, 8 icing colors, cookie icing bottle with 2 tips and 3-piece cookie decorating tool set
Meringue mix net weight: 8 ounce (226 gram); Contains egg; Made in a facility that also processes peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish, milk and wheat
Icing colors include Leaf Green, Lemon Yellow, Christmas Red, Sky Blue, Brown, Orange, Pink and Violet; Net Weight: 0.5 ounce (14 gram) each
Icing colors contain sulfites; Made on equipment that also processes milk, soy, wheat, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and shellfish
Silicone icing bottle is microwave safe; Hand wash in warm, soapy water; Rinse and dry thoroughly
Meringue mix and icing colors made in the USA
description: You'll be decorating cookies with all kinds of sweet designs when you grab this set. Start with our meringue powder to whip up some royal icing, then tint it up to 8 different shades with icing colors in Leaf Green, Lemon Yellow, Christmas Red, Sky Blue, Brown, Orange, Pink and Violet. Fill the silicone decorating bottle, and with the large tip, ice the tops of your cookies. Switch to the small tip to drizzle, write messages or add details. Make unique royal icing effects with the 3-piece decorating tool set. Use the etching tool (scribe) for feathering and marbling, the three-prong comb to pull colors on wet icing, or the silicone scraping tool for creating smooth, precise edges. In order to help cut down on extra packaging waste, each individual product in your set will arrive together in the same plain brown box.
